notes: Identity verified from title, four named authors, DOI 10.3758/s13414-019-01723-6, journal volume/pages and full report structure (methods, results, discussion, references). Canonical text is a primary article PDF parse, not an abstract or secondary report. No source PDF path was supplied, so no rendering was possible or attempted. Supplied replication locator p. 7 corresponds to Experiment 3 visual search (printed p. 2326), whereas the neutral description identifies Experiment 1 Stroop; extraction follows the explicit task/outcome and records the locator discrepancy. Original study 3 does not identify a replication experiment by number. Printed partial eta squared is preserved without conversion to eta squared. RT interaction is the critical posture effect on Stroop interference; congruency main effect (.21, p=.047), accuracy interaction (.10, p=.25), and seated/standing within-posture one-sample t tests are distinct tests, not substitutions. Fourteen is an experiment-specific participant count, but no explicit final analytic N statement was located in the target Method/Results; no N is inferred from degrees of freedom and no summation is performed. Original side is an unassigned placeholder.
